column3: “Balances of righteousness” is rendered “accurate scales,” and “acknowledge” as “know.”
“My produce” is rendered “my crops”; it may mean “my offspring.”
“Bow down over her” is rendered “kneel down over her.”
The written and read forms differ; “wickedness” is rendered “a lustful crime,” and “iniquity of judges” as “an iniquity punishable by judges.”
“He grew up with me like a father” is rendered “he grew up with me as with a father”; NASB uses parentheses. The meaning is uncertain.
“Brandished … my hand” is rendered “lifted up my hand.”
“Gullible” is rendered “enticed,” and “kissed my hand to my mouth” as “my hand threw a kiss from my mouth.”
“Disaster” is rendered “extinction,” and “if” as a question.
“My palate” is rendered “my mouth”; NASB adds “No.”
